forensic_method: Exact original proposition first; separate speech date, source publication and collection clocks; distinguish quoted speech from attributed paraphrase and reported planning from execution. Independent verification of publication does not verify operational fact. A counterparty denial or lack of access is not affirmative proof of falsity. FALSE and knowledge-of-falsity require independent findings; source/actor roles and corrections require evidenced edges. Do not backdate later sources.
